component.name: WhySlow
component.summary: Find out why your Linux system just stuttered, froze or crashed

description.p: WhySlow records a few seconds of system health every second and, when something feels slow, tells you in plain English which program caused it and what to do.

ul.li: Black box: explains why the system froze or crashed, even after a hard reset
Names the culprit, what it is, and whether it is safe to stop
Game stutter: correlates MangoHud frame times with what the system was doing
Hardware gotchas: slow USB ports, narrow PCIe links, missing TRIM, ntfs-3g and more
Laptop battery: which program drains the battery
Slow boot: which stage and service delayed the desktop
Shareable report with personal details removed; nothing is uploaded

screenshot.caption: WhySlow explaining a CPU slowdown and naming the culprit
